:::{#def-mean-function}
#### Mean function

The **mean function** $\mean$ of an outcome $\Outvar$ given a covariate $\Predvar$
maps each covariate value $\predvar$ to the mean of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar = \predvar$:

$$
\truemeanf{\predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar = \predvar}.
$$ {#eq-mean-function}

:::
